title: Good brush
text: Good brush. I love these brushes. I used one for cleaning and scrubbing pans with stuck on food. The bristles are nice and sturdy and hold up to the scrubbing without bending away. It is comfortable to hold in my hand. Easy to use for a good scrub job on anything.
